Thesis Management System — User Manual

ระบบจัดการวิทยานิพนธ์ · ภาควิชาวิศวกรรมเครื่องกล คณะวิศวกรรมศาสตร์ จุฬาลงกรณ์มหาวิทยาลัย

For students, advisors, committee members, program chairs, the department head and department staff. All screenshots are from the system in Thai, the language it is normally used in. Captured 6 October 2026.

Part 1System Overview

What the system does

The system replaces passing paper forms from desk to desk. A student's request — first the thesis proposal exam (สอบโครงร่างวิทยานิพนธ์), then the thesis defense (สอบวิทยานิพนธ์) — moves through a fixed sequence of steps. At each step exactly one person (or one group, in order) has to act: download the current document, sign it, upload the signed copy, tick a short checklist and press the button. The system then notifies the next person by email and in-app notification.

  • One proposal at a time. A student always starts with a proposal. The defense can only be created after the proposal is complete, and it imports the committee from it.
  • Signing is still done on the document. The system does not create signatures. Each signer signs the PDF (electronically or on paper and scanned) and uploads it; every upload becomes a new version.
  • Everyone sees the same timeline. The student, each committee member and the staff can all see which step the request is on and who it is waiting for.

Who uses it

Everyone signs in with their own account. One account can play different roles on different requests — for example a professor may be advisor on one thesis and exam committee member on another.

RoleThaiWhat they do in the system
StudentนิสิตCreates the request, chooses the committee, uploads forms, follows progress.
Advisorอาจารย์ที่ปรึกษาSigns forms; in the defense, records the exam result and fills in the result report.
Co-advisorอาจารย์ที่ปรึกษาร่วมOptional, may be several. Signs after the advisor, in list order.
Head of exam committeeประธานกรรมการสอบSigns; in the proposal also records ผ่าน / ไม่ผ่าน.
Exam committeeกรรมการสอบOne or more internal faculty. Sign one after another.
External memberกรรมการภายนอกOne or more examiners from outside the department, with their own accounts.
Program chairประธานหลักสูตรSigns บ.วศ.1 and บ.2. Set automatically from the student's program.
Department headหัวหน้าภาควิชาSigns the memos to the Faculty, the defense result report and บ.4.
Department staffเจ้าหน้าที่ภาควิชาChecks every package, generates the finance form and memos, sends documents to the Faculty, manages accounts and settings.

People outside the system — the Faculty (คณะฯ), the Dean, the finance office and the Graduate School — receive documents by email or through the Faculty's LessPaper system; they do not sign in.

Signing in

Open the system's address and sign in with your email and passcode (รหัสเข้าใช้งาน). You are taken straight to your own dashboard.

  • There is no self-registration. Department staff create every account and the passcode is sent to your email.
  • There is no "forgot passcode" link. If you lose it, contact department staff — they can reset it and the new passcode is emailed to you.
  • Notification emails contain a plain link to the sign-in page. You always sign in with your email and passcode; there is no automatic log-in link.

The screen

Every role sees the same top bar: system name and today's date on the left, your name and email in the middle, and on the right the language switch (TH/EN), the notification bell and Logout.

Notification bell

The red badge counts unread notifications. Open the bell to see what happened on your requests — "ถึงคิวของท่าน" (it is your turn) is highlighted in orange. Click a notification to go straight to that request. อ่านทั้งหมด marks everything as read.

Every "your turn" notification is also sent by email.

Language

The TH button shows the current language; click it to switch the interface to English. Document names and people's names stay in Thai.

Status of a request

BadgeMeaning
ฉบับร่าง (Draft)The student is still filling in the request. Nobody else is involved yet.
กำลังดำเนินการ (In progress)Moving through the steps.
ถูกปฏิเสธ (Rejected)A reviewer rejected the current step. It waits for the student to fix and resubmit (see Q&A).
เสร็จสิ้น (Completed)All steps are done.
ยกเลิกแล้ว (Cancelled)Cancelled by staff at the student's request.

The step list (ขั้นตอนทั้งหมด) shows every step with its status: a green tick for approved, a blue clock for the current step, red for rejected, grey for not yet reached. Steps where several people sign (for example 5.5 กรรมการสอบ) list each person and whether they have signed.

The action card — what you do when it is your turn

When a request is waiting for you, a blue-framed card titled ดำเนินการ (or the name of your role) appears on the right of the request page. Every role's card is built the same way, top to bottom:

  1. ดาวน์โหลดเอกสาร — download the latest version of the document(s) for this step.
  2. ลงนามในเอกสาร — sign the downloaded file and save it as a PDF.
  3. อัปโหลดเอกสาร — pick the signed PDF. The box turns blue and shows "✓ เลือกไฟล์แล้ว". Nothing is uploaded yet.
  4. Checklist (yellow box) — tick each item to confirm what you did. The main button stays disabled until every item is ticked and every required file is picked.
  5. หมายเหตุ — an optional note, visible to the others on the timeline.
  6. ส่งต่อ (green) — uploads the files and passes the request to the next person.
    ปฏิเสธ (red) — reject with a reason; the student must fix and resubmit.

Department staff see อนุมัติ (approve) and ส่งกลับ (send back one step) instead — staff steps never use ปฏิเสธ.

Sections a step does not need are left out and the rest are renumbered. For example a staff check has only download → checklist → อนุมัติ.

Dashboards by role

Student

Three tabs: สอบโครงร่าง (proposal), สอบวิทยานิพนธ์ (defense) and กรรมการภายนอก (request an account for an external examiner). The page opens on the defense tab once a defense exists. Each tab shows the request's details, the step list and, when it is the student's turn, the action card — everything is done on this one page.

Professors and external members

A list of every request you are part of, in any role, with status filters (ทั้งหมด / ฉบับร่าง / กำลังดำเนินการ / เสร็จสิ้น / ถูกปฏิเสธ / ยกเลิกแล้ว). Requests waiting for you come first and carry an orange badge naming the step. After you act, the badge shows "ท่านอนุมัติแล้ว". Click a card to open the request and its action card.

Department staff

Three tabs. จัดการคำร้อง (requests) opens with an orange box "งานที่ต้องดำเนินการ" listing everything waiting for staff, then the full request list with search and status filters; clicking a request expands it in place. จัดการผู้ใช้งาน manages accounts and approves external-examiner requests. ตั้งค่าระบบ sets the department head, the program chair of each program and the finance contact.

Files and forms

  • PDF only for every form you upload (up to 20 MB). The finance form is the only Word (.docx) file, and only staff handle it.
  • Blank forms are on the department download page, me.eng.chula.ac.th/download — the upload boxes link there.
  • Every upload is a new version. The file list always shows the latest version of each form; older versions are kept under ประวัติ (history).
  • Click a file to preview it in a new tab; the download buttons in the action card save it to your computer.

Part 2Proposal Workflow · สอบโครงร่างวิทยานิพนธ์

The proposal has 10 steps. Steps 1–3 cover บ.วศ.1ก and 1ข before the exam; the proposal exam itself happens outside the system, between step 3 and step 4; steps 4–10 cover บ.วศ.1ค and 1ง after it. Each section below says who acts, what they do, and what everyone else sees meanwhile.

Step map

StudentStaffProgram chairCommitteeDepartment head
StepWhoWhat
1StudentUpload บ.วศ.1 with 1ก + 1ข filled in (signed by the student and the advisor)
2StaffCheck; generate the finance form; approve → finance office is emailed
3Program chairSign บ.วศ.1ก
— Proposal exam (outside the system) —
4StudentFill in บ.วศ.1ค + 1ง and upload
5.1Head of committeeRecord ผ่าน/ไม่ผ่าน; sign บ.วศ.1ค

Throughout the proposal the student and committee work on one combined PDF, บ.วศ.1 (1ก–1ง). Each signer downloads the latest version, signs their part and uploads it back as the next version.

Creating the request Student

On the สอบโครงร่าง tab a student with no proposal sees the blank form, greyed out, so they can see what will be needed. Click + สร้างร่างคำร้อง to start a draft.

  1. ข้อมูลวิทยานิพนธ์ — the thesis title.
  2. ข้อมูลนิสิต — choose the program (หลักสูตร); the program chair fills in automatically. Name, student ID and email come from the account; add a phone number.
  3. ผู้รับผิดชอบวิทยานิพนธ์ — the committee (next).
  4. ข้อมูลการสอบ — exam date and time, and whether a meeting room or parking for external members is needed.

บันทึกฉบับร่าง saves what you have so far — you can leave and come back. Nothing is sent to anyone until you tick the confirmation box and press ยืนยัน — ขอสอบโครงร่างวิทยานิพนธ์.

Choosing the committee

Each row is one person: choose the role on the left, then the person on the right. Only people who already have an account can be chosen. Use + เพิ่มบุคคล to add rows and × to remove one.

  • Required: 1 advisor, 1 head of exam committee, at least 1 exam committee member and at least 1 external member. Co-advisors are optional. The green chips above the rows tick off as each requirement is met.
  • Row order is signing order. Where several people share a role, they sign in the order of the rows. Drag the handle on the left of a row (⋮⋮) to reorder.
  • The hint under each row ("เลือกจาก: …") says which kind of account that role accepts. For a PhD the head of the exam committee must be an external account; for a master's degree it may be internal or external. See Q&A.
  • One person, one position — except the program chair, who may also hold one other position.
  • If an external examiner is not in the list, request an account on the กรรมการภายนอก tab first (see Q&A).

Exam details and confirmation

Enter the planned exam date and time. Tick the confirmation box, then press ยืนยัน — ขอสอบโครงร่างวิทยานิพนธ์. The request becomes กำลังดำเนินการ and step 1 opens for the student.

If you change your mind before confirming, ไม่ต้องการยื่นขอสอบโครงร่างวิทยานิพนธ์ตอนนี้ discards the draft.

Meanwhile: no one else sees a draft. On confirmation, department staff are notified.

Step 4 · after the proposal exam

4

Fill in บ.วศ.1ค + 1ง

Student

หลังสอบโครงร่างแล้ว — นิสิตอัปโหลด บ.วศ.1 (กรอก บ.วศ.1ค + บ.วศ.1ง)

  1. Download the latest บ.วศ.1 — it already carries the program chair's signature.
  2. Fill in 1ค and 1ง according to the committee's comments at the exam. Type the committee names, but leave all signature areas and all dates blank.
  3. Make sure the thesis title in 1ง is exactly what the committee agreed — it is sent to the Faculty and registered in the university's system as written.
  4. Upload the file as a new version, tick the 9 checks, press ส่งต่อ.

The upload must be newer than the program chair's signature; an older file does not count.

Steps 5.1–5.5 · the committee signs บ.วศ.1ค

Step 5 is one step with sub-steps, one for each committee role, in this fixed order. Every member signs exactly one place on บ.วศ.1ค. Where a role has several people, they sign one after another in the order the student listed them; each person is notified only when it is their turn.

Head of the exam committee

Choose the exam result, ผ่าน (pass) or ไม่ผ่าน (fail) — it is recorded on the timeline for everyone to see. Then download, sign บ.วศ.1ค, upload, tick and press ส่งต่อ.

Committee

อาจารย์ที่ปรึกษาลงนาม บ.วศ.1ค

Same card as the program chair's: download, sign, upload, tick, ส่งต่อ. If something in the form is wrong, press ปฏิเสธ and write what must be fixed — in this example the advisor did exactly that once; see Q&A: a step was rejected.

5.3

Co-advisors, in order

Committee

อาจารย์ที่ปรึกษาร่วมลงนาม บ.วศ.1ค

The card for a multi-person step is titled with the role and shows a progress line (ลงนาม 0/2) and the list of members. The one whose turn it is is marked (ท่าน) and กำลังรอ. A member whose turn has not come yet sees the same list with a note to wait; the buttons are not available to them.

This sub-step is skipped entirely, and not numbered, when the student named no co-advisor.

Steps 5.4 (external members) and 5.5 (exam committee) work the same way. In the example the exam committee is อ.ดร.การุ then รศ.ดร.จิตติน.

Part 3Defense Workflow · สอบวิทยานิพนธ์

The defense has 17 steps. Steps 1–5 prepare the exam (บ.2 and บ.3 to the Faculty); the exam itself happens between step 5 and step 6; steps 6–11 deliver the exam result; steps 12–17 submit the thesis and finish in iThesis.

2StaffCheck; generate the finance form; approve → finance office is emailed

5StaffForward the Faculty's email to the student; confirm
— Thesis defense exam (outside the system) —

Creating the request Student

Once the proposal is complete, opening the สอบวิทยานิพนธ์ tab creates the defense draft automatically, with the title, student details and the whole committee imported from the proposal.

  • The committee can still be changed — add, remove or reorder people exactly as in the proposal. Changes apply to the defense only; the completed proposal is never modified.
  • Student details and the program come from the proposal and cannot be changed here.
  • Enter the defense exam date and time, the room and parking needs (with the car plate if parking is requested), tick the confirmation box and press ยืนยัน — ขอสอบวิทยานิพนธ์.
Meanwhile: on confirmation, staff are notified and step 1 opens for the student.

Part 4Questions & Answers

Accounts and signing in

I forgot my passcode.

Contact department staff. They reset it from the user list, and the new passcode is emailed to you. There is no self-service reset.

How do I get an account?

Department staff create all accounts. Students are created by staff before their first request. External examiners get an account when staff approve a student's request (next question).

My external examiner is not in the list.

On the student dashboard, open the กรรมการภายนอก tab and submit the examiner's title, name, email, affiliation and phone. Staff review it under จัดการผู้ใช้งาน; once approved, the account exists, the examiner receives a welcome email with their passcode, and you can select them in the committee list. You are notified of the decision either way. Internal faculty accounts are created by staff directly — ask them if a professor is missing.

The emails link to the sign-in page, not to the request. Why?

For security, emails never log you in automatically. Sign in with your email and passcode; the notification bell then takes you straight to the request.

Committee

Why can't I choose this person for this role?

Which kind of account may fill each role depends on the degree:

RoleMaster's (ME_MECH / ME_CPS)Doctoral (PhD)Number
AdvisorInternalInternalexactly 1
Co-advisorInternal or externalInternal or external0 or more
Head of exam committeeInternal or externalExternal onlyexactly 1
Exam committeeInternalInternal1 or more
External memberExternalExternal1 or more

Also, a person already chosen for one role is no longer offered for another, because each person may hold only one position. The exception is the program chair, who may hold one more.

A committee row turned red when I reopened my draft.

The person on that row can no longer be used — their account was removed, or you changed the program and they no longer fit the role (for example an internal head of committee after switching to PhD). Choose someone else or delete the row. The draft cannot be saved or confirmed until it is fixed, so that no one is dropped silently.

Who decides the signing order?

The order of the rows in the committee list. Drag a row by its handle to change it before confirming. After the request has started, only staff can change the committee (they use the same editor); steps that are not yet done adjust to the new list, and signatures already given by people who stay are kept.

Who is the program chair on my request?

It is set automatically from your program, as assigned by staff in ตั้งค่าระบบ. Students cannot change it. If the field says no chair is assigned, contact staff — the request cannot be confirmed without one.

Moving the request along

A step was rejected. What happens now?

When a reviewer presses ปฏิเสธ they must write a reason. The request stays on the same step and turns ถูกปฏิเสธ. The student sees a red box with who rejected it and why, and an แก้ไขเอกสาร card. Fix the document, upload it there and press ยื่นใหม่อีกครั้ง. The same reviewer is notified and reviews the step again — the request does not go back to the beginning.

What is ส่งกลับ (send back)?

A staff-only action. It reopens the current step and the step before it, so the previous person must act again — for example if a signer uploaded the wrong file. Staff can also reopen any earlier step from "จัดการแต่ละขั้นตอน" on the request page. A reason is optional and appears in the notification.

The green button is grey and I can't press it.

Every required file must be picked and every checklist item ticked. Look for a yellow line just above the button — it says what is missing. At step 4 of the proposal and some later steps, the file must also be newer than the previous step; re-pick the file if you picked an old one.

I picked the wrong file.

Before pressing the button, click × เลือกไฟล์ใหม่ and pick again — nothing is uploaded until you press the button. After pressing it, the file is uploaded; ask the next reviewer to reject (or staff to send back) so you can upload the correct one. Earlier versions always remain visible under ประวัติ.

Several committee members share a role — why can't I sign yet?

Members sign one after another in list order. Your card shows the list; when the member before you signs, you receive "ถึงคิวของท่าน" by email and in the bell.

How do I cancel my request?

Press ขอยกเลิกคำร้องนี้ under the request. This only sends a request to staff: the submission shows "รออนุมัติยกเลิก" and is frozen until staff accept or decline. If accepted, it becomes ยกเลิกแล้ว and (for a proposal) you may start a new one; if declined, it continues where it was. A completed request cannot be cancelled.

Documents

Where do I get the blank forms?

From the department download page, me.eng.chula.ac.th/download (the upload boxes link there). The post-exam forms of the defense — แบบรายงานฯ and ใบรายงานผลการสอบ — come in the Faculty's email that staff forward at defense step 5.

Does the system sign documents for me?

No. Sign the downloaded PDF yourself (electronic signature, or print–sign–scan), save it as PDF and upload it. The checklist confirms what you signed.

Why can't the student see the finance form?

The committee finance form is internal to the department and the finance office; it is hidden from the student on purpose.

What is the LessPaper receipt document?

The Faculty's LessPaper system stamps each package staff send with a receipt number. Staff upload that stamped document at each delivery step (proposal step 10; defense steps 4, 11 and 15) as proof of delivery.

What extra is needed when the result is ดีมาก?

The student fills in แบบประเมินวิทยานิพนธ์ดีมาก (at defense step 6 the form is uploaded in every case — blank unless the result is ดีมาก). The advisor confirms it at step 7 and staff check it at step 9.

Who can see my request?

The student, everyone on its committee, the program chair, the department head and department staff. Nobody else.
